level_custom.description: Your own mix of savers, not one of the levels

level_off_desc.message: Saving is paused. Your YouTube limit stays on.

level_light_desc.message: Blocks heavy trackers. Pages look and play as usual.

level_balanced_desc.message: Also stops videos from playing and downloading on their own.

level_max_desc.message: Also blocks images. Pages look unfinished; turn images back on for a site you need.

saver_autoplay_saves.message: Videos and sound don't play or download until you press play.

saver_autoplay_breaks.message: Some players need a second click. YouTube videos you open still play.
saver_autoplay_breaks.description: What the autoplay saver may break

saver_trackers_saves.message: Ads and tracking scripts that load on page after page.

saver_trackers_breaks.message: Rarely breaks anything, though "Log in with Facebook" buttons may not work. For much more blocking, use uBlock Origin.
saver_trackers_breaks.description: What the trackers saver may break

saver_images_saves.message: Photos and pictures, often the largest part of a page.

saver_images_breaks.message: Pages look unfinished. Turn images back on for a site with a site rule.
saver_images_breaks.description: What the images saver may break

saver_fonts_saves.message: Font files a site downloads the first time you visit it.

saver_fonts_breaks.message: Icons may turn into words like "menu", and text uses your system's fonts.
saver_fonts_breaks.description: What the fonts saver may break

saver_saveData_saves.message: Sites that honour it send smaller images and video.

saver_saveData_breaks.message: Few sites honour it, and it makes your browser a little easier to tell apart from others.

yt_cost_240.description: What an hour of YouTube costs at this quality

yt_cost_360.description: What an hour of YouTube costs at this quality

yt_cost_480.description: What an hour of YouTube costs at this quality

yt_cost_720.description: What an hour of YouTube costs at this quality

yt_cost_1080.description: What an hour of YouTube costs at this quality

yt_cost_0.message: up to 3 GB an hour or more
yt_cost_0.description: What an hour of YouTube costs with no limit

yt_applied_now.description: After lowering the limit: the playing video changes now

yt_from_next.description: After raising the limit: it applies from the next video

yt_levels_note.message: Saving levels never change your YouTube quality.

level_everything_light.description: Max/Balanced card: includes the level below

level_light_breaks.message: Rarely anything; "Log in with Facebook" on other sites

level_balanced_breaks.message: Some players need a second click

level_max_breaks.message: Pages look bare; show images again site by site
